units.source_text: 我忽然想起初次与柏木相会时他对我说过的一句话：

en.t: I suddenly remembered something Kashiwagi had said to me when we first met:

units.source_text: 那是在这样一瞬间，即一个晴朗的春天的下午，

en.t: is found in just such a moment, on a clear spring afternoon,

units.source_text: 在精心修剪过的草坪上茫然地望着透过叶隙筛落下来的阳光嬉戏的一瞬间。"

en.t: in the instant when we gaze blankly from a carefully trimmed lawn at the sunlight playing as it filters down through the leaves."
